hero.headline: Frontend Developer & Applied AI Engineer.
hero.description: I lead the Artificial Intelligence strategy of a media company with 300+ employees, designing and deploying AI systems in production. I combine a solid frontend foundation with AI systems engineering: RAG, data pipelines, automation, and infrastructure.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a developer with 6+ years of frontend experience who evolved into technical leadership of enterprise AI. Today I lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence within a media group of 300+ employees: I define the strategy, build the tools, and establish the governance framework under which the organization uses AI safely.
about.p2: My work doesn't stop at experimentation. I design architectures, integrate models with internal systems, deploy on production servers, and document every decision. I understand both the code and the business context, and that combination is what turns an AI idea into a system the company depends on.
about.p3: I don't define myself only as a developer or only as a strategist. I sit at the intersection: I understand engineering well enough to build systems that work, and business well enough to make those systems solve problems that matter.
about.highlight1_desc: RAG systems, LLM integration, processing pipelines, embeddings and semantic search
about.highlight2_desc: System design, production deployment, APIs (FastAPI), vector databases
about.highlight3_desc: User interfaces, tracking and analytics (GA4, GTM), digital property integration

project1.title: Contextualizer — The Medium's Memory
project1.description: Production RAG system for semantic retrieval over the publication's historical archive. It lets journalists query decades of content in natural language and instantly retrieve relevant context.
project1.problem: The medium's knowledge existed in its historical archive but was inaccessible on demand: journalists couldn't retrieve relevant context when they needed it.
project1.solution: Complete RAG architecture: archive ingestion and chunking, vectorization with local embeddings, similarity search, and contextualized generation. Scope limited to the medium's corpus and local embeddings for independence from external vectorization services.
project1.results: Natural-language querying of decades of archive · Instant editorial context · Independence from external services

project2.title: AI Traffic Light — Data Governance
project2.description: Production governance classifier that determines, before any data leaves the organization toward an external AI service, whether that transfer is safe, with a clear traffic-light verdict.
project2.problem: The risk decision (legal, compliance, reputational) about sending data to external AI services was being made inconsistently.
project2.solution: A system that turns that risk decision into an automated, consistent answer. Local hosting was evaluated to resolve the core contradiction: it makes no sense to send data to an external service to ask whether that data can be sent to an external service.
project2.results: Automated, consistent risk decision · Clear traffic-light verdict · Data protected before it leaves
project2.tech: Claude API, Classification architecture, Production deployment

project3.title: Interview Transcription Pipeline
project3.description: Audio-to-text processing pipeline that turns journalistic interview audio into clean, structured transcriptions, combining speech recognition with LLM post-processing.
project3.problem: Manual interview transcription is one of the most time-consuming tasks in journalistic work.
project3.solution: Automation that combines speech recognition (Whisper) with LLM post-processing for cleanup and organization, delivering clean, structured transcriptions.
project3.results: Clean, structured transcriptions · Removes a costly manual task · Faster journalistic workflow

project4.title: Outbound Campaign Infrastructure — WhatsApp Business
project4.description: End-to-end enablement of the company's outbound marketing channel. I led the evaluation and selection of the WhatsApp Business provider (BSP), designed the campaign flow architecture, and implemented the automation.
project4.problem: The company had no enabled outbound marketing channel and no formal process to select its WhatsApp Business provider.
project4.solution: BSP selection via a formal comparative rubric with onboarding criteria (API-only vs. Coexistence depending on account status), campaign flow design, automation, and integration with the media API for message creation and sending.
project4.results: Outbound channel enabled end-to-end · Provider selected with a formal rubric · Automated campaign sending
project4.tech: BSP (WhatsApp Business API), n8n, Workflow automation, Media API

project5.title: E-commerce Platform
project5.description: High-performance online store with a headless architecture designed to handle major traffic spikes.
project5.problem: Operations needed to scale during campaigns and peak seasons without checkout failures or slowdowns.
project5.solution: Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, plus layered caching, smart prefetching, and optimized critical queries.
project5.results: Stable checkout under high peaks · Fast navigation · Solid foundation for growth

project6.title: Astro + WordPress Headless
project6.description: WordPress portal modernization keeping wp-admin while moving the frontend to a faster experience.
project6.problem: The existing portal was slow, and the editorial team needed to keep their usual WordPress publishing flow.
project6.solution: Headless architecture: content served from WordPress and frontend rebuilt with Astro, prioritizing performance and operational continuity.
project6.results: Improved load time · Same editorial workflow · Better UX
project6.tech: Astro, WordPress Headless, REST API, JavaScript

project7.title: Pigasus
project7.description: Restaurant e-commerce in Medellin with an end-to-end operation from payment to kitchen execution.
project7.problem: The business needed full digital order flow: payment, internal processing, and user tracking.
project7.solution: WordPress commerce setup with payment gateway integration, direct kitchen order routing, and order status tracker.
project7.results: Centralized orders · Less operational friction · Better customer visibility

project8.title: Enterprise RPA System
project8.description: Automation for reporting and data management processes that previously required extensive manual work.
project8.problem: The finance team spent 8 hours daily building Excel reports with high risk of human error.
project8.solution: RPA bot with Power Automate and Rocketbot that extracts, processes, validates, and generates reports automatically.
project8.tech: Power Automate, Rocketbot, Excel API, SQL Server, Python

project9.title: Internal Projects
project9.description: Collection of projects where I started: mostly WordPress, plus implementations in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
project9.problem: Need to build functional solutions with limited resources while strengthening core technical foundations through real projects.
project9.solution: Continuous delivery of sites and digital specials with a practical mindset, improving web structure and implementation quality over time.
project9.results: Strong technical foundation · Visible professional growth · High learning volume
